subject: Kickoff: pruning toolkit for the efficiency portfolio
body:
Hi Ivo,

Kicking off the pruning-toolkit project (Mar 9 – May 18). The base is our open-source model-pruning library: it injects pruning ops into the training graph so models are pruned while they train — you wrap a layer's weights with apply_mask and get mask and threshold variables that control which weights participate in the forward pass. The extension we care about is the newer gradient-based pruning ops alongside the classic magnitude-based ones.

Product framing: three model teams asked for a supported "train sparse" path this half. Serving cost is the efficiency portfolio's headline OKR, and block sparsity is what actually buys us hardware speedups rather than paper sparsity.

Milestones: end of March — library adopted by first pilot team with masks stripped for deployment; late April — magnitude vs gradient-based comparison on two internal models; mid-May — sparsity-vs-quality recommendation report.

Staffing and compute by Mar 20?

Zofia
